elements.text: L R  FLIP PAGES        A  OPEN        Z  FAVOURITE        START  SETTINGS
the stock buttons  —  remap any of them in the builder
Back  —  up a folder, or one page
Favourite  —  add to or drop from a shelf
C buttons  —  skip a page at a time

Press Z on any game to save it.
Press Z again to remove it.
